title: Mobile Defense/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Lotus: "This is a mobile defense mission. You must deliver the payloads and defend a number of locations while I break into the network. Be prepared for heavy resistance. I can't do this without you."
- Lotus: "This will only get more difficult. Get to a terminal and prepare for enemy resistance."
- Lotus: "We have got to find a terminal. Proceed and prepare!"
- Lotus: "I need access to a terminal, find one and patch me in!"
- Lotus: "Location reached: Drop me in and defend our position!"
- Lotus: "Terminal spotted. Upload me and prepare to defend."
- Lotus: "Here is a terminal: Get me in, and get ready to defend!"
- Lotus: "I'm in Tenno. This will take a moment."
- Lotus: "Still working on it, continue to defend!"
- Lotus: "All Terminals have been successfully hacked. Excellent resistance, Tenno. Let's make our exit!"
- Lotus: "The odds were against us, Tenno, but we did it. Mission complete."

path: If Sentients spawn and pauses timer
lines: - Lotus: "The Sentient mind has scrambled the systems. Eliminate all Sentients before I can continue."
- Lotus: "The Sentients are causing too much interference, you have to deal with them before we can go on."
- Lotus: "This isn't working, it's the Sentients, take them out."
- Lotus: "Sentient forces eliminated. We can continue."
- Lotus: "That's it, they're all gone. We can resume our mission."
- Lotus: "All data logs indicate that there is an Orokin Artifact somewhere here, get to it now, defend it, and then we can leave!"
- Lotus: "Artifact found. Defend it until the Extraction Team arrives."
- Lotus: "I must extract crucial surveillance data from nearby satellites. Protect them until I complete my task."
- Lotus: "Satellites in the vicinity contain important surveillance data, defend them while I extract that data."
- Lotus: "This is it, defend the satellite while I extract what we need."
- Lotus: "Do not let the enemy destroy this satellite before I have what we need."
- Lotus: "I have the data, move onto the next target."
- Lotus: "I got what we need. Find the next satellite."
- Lotus: "The enemy would rather destroy this data than have it let it land in our hands."
- Lotus: "The surveillance data is heavily encrypted, it will take time to extract."
- Lotus: "All satellites have been hacked. Move to extraction."
- Lotus: "Mission accomplished, proceed to your landing craft."

- Hombask: "Housekeeping time. There's whole sectors of the Zariman whose systems have rotted ever since the jump. I've prepped you a datamass that will bring them back under our control. But you'll need to pop it in the right nodes and keep the systems safe while it purges."

- Hombask: "We need to take back this ship one room at a time. That means getting back control of the network. That datamass will scrub a whole sector clean if you can get them in the right port and let it work in peace."
- Hombask: "Keeping our home in order means having control of the ship's systems. Right now, we don't have that. You'll gonna have to go in with a datamass and manually bring consoles back online."
- Hombask: "There's a terminal! Plug in the thingy and keep it in one piece."
- Hombask: "Terminal in sight. You know what to do."
- Hombask: "You found a terminal. Pop the datamass in there and defend it."
- Hombask: "System's clean. Great work. Keep moving."
- Hombask: "Job done. On to the next."
- Hombask: "This system is back online. Find us another."
- Hombask: "You just brought an entire sector back to functionality. I'm proud of you. Take a hard earned break."
- Hombask: "Old fashion elbow grease and a bit of brute force can work miracles. Sector's ours. Well done."
- Hombask: "Systems are waking up across a whole sector. I'll send some cleaning drones in and get it ready for use. You did good."
